parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: true.

- **true**: enabled.
- **false**: disabled.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Use a different value for each creation request.

parameters.name: DBInstanceDescription
parameters.description: The description of the instance.

parameters.name: DBNodeClass
parameters.description: The node specifications code of PolarDBX Search data nodes. Available specifications depend on the region and sales configuration. Use a PolarDBX Search specification code that is available for purchase in the current region.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The PolarDBX Search DPI engine version. The value is fixed to 3.0. If this parameter is not specified, the default value 3.0 is used.

parameters.name: InstanceSpec
parameters.description: A compatible parameter that does not take effect. Use DBNodeClass to specify the PolarDBX Search data node specifications.

parameters.name: NodeCount
parameters.description: The number of PolarDBX Search data nodes. The value must be a positive integer and a multiple of the number of selected zones.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance.

- **PREPAY**: subscription.
- **POSTPAY**: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The billing cycle. Valid values for subscription: Year and Month. Default value for pay-as-you-go: Hour.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the instance resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: StorageSpace
parameters.description: The storage space per node, in GB. The value must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description: The storage type. Default value: cloud_auto.

parameters.name: TopologyType
parameters.description:
The topology type. Valid values:

- **1azone**: single active zone.
- **3azones**: three active zones.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. Specify the number of months or years for prepaid instances.

> When Period is set to Year, valid values for this parameter are 1, 2, and 3.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description: VPC ID。

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: Zone2
parameters.description: The second zone. This parameter is required when TopologyType is set to 3azones. The value cannot be the same as other zones.

parameters.name: Zone3
parameters.description: The third zone. This parameter is required when TopologyType is set to 3azones. The value cannot be the same as other zones.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone of the instance.
